request.text: Remind me later to latch the rabbit hutch before it gets dark.

responsibilities.outcome: Arrange a reminder for the user to latch the rabbit hutch before dark, after resolving when the reminder should occur.

interpretation_unresolved: The request does not specify a clock time or an unambiguous trigger for when the reminder should fire.

new_goals.description: Set a reminder to latch the rabbit hutch before dark once its trigger time is clarified.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me later to latch the rabbit hutch before it gets dark.
constraints: The reminder must occur before dark.
The meaning of later is unresolved and no clock time is supplied.
success_criteria: A user-confirmed reminder time or trigger is obtained before any reminder is created.

semantic_facts: The planner should ask for a concrete reminder time or a user-resolvable trigger because later and before dark do not identify when the reminder should fire.
forbidden_claims: The assistant guesses a time, silently treats sunset as an available scheduling trigger, or claims that a reminder has already been created.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A consequential missing scheduling parameter is guessed instead of clarified.
The presence of a reminder capability causes premature execution despite unresolved trigger semantics.
